result: Partial-identifiability research maps to a concrete WP804 source gap: ambiguous public evidence can be paired with an exact evaluator-hidden goal label, and score_goal_inference can then mark an arbitrary exact guess correct because no evaluator-side identifiability gate is enforced. Existing public/private fences and ABSTAIN behavior are useful but do not fail closed against contradictory exact labels on the same ambiguity-preserving evidence.
minimal_fix: Add evaluator-side identifiability/equivalence semantics plus matched non-identifying/discriminating fixture pairs and hidden-label permutation falsifier. Keep policy input public-only. Do not import a full IRL framework and do not widen GoalContract authority.
